title: The Whistler
paragraphs: A dark crime anthology narrated by the all-knowing Whistler, whose stories often follow ordinary people into murder, greed, or deception before ending with irony or unexpected justice.

CBS mystery/crime anthology whose recurring Whistler narrator frames self-contained stories. The current 2026 specialist project distinguishes the West Coast, Eastern spurs, military/syndicated copies, and the final East-only broadcasts. GRH currently ends with the final West Coast broadcast on 1955-09-08.

GRH documents the program through Early sustaining West Coast era (May 16, 1942 to December 18, 1943) on [[org|org.5d1a575385a05456|CBS Pacific Network]], Signal Oil West Coast era (December 19, 1943 to October 17, 1954) on [[org|org.5d1a575385a05456|CBS Pacific Network]], and Final split national era (February 27, 1955 to September 22, 1955) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Wilbur Hatch (music on 324 recordings, composer on 41 recordings, conductor on 39 recordings, writer on 3 recordings, and performer on 1 recording), George W. Allen (producer on 254 recordings, director on 131 recordings, production on 1 recording, and writer on 1 recording), Marvin Miller (announcer on 223 recordings, performer on 62 recordings, music on 1 recording, and narrator on 1 recording), Bill Forman (performer on 94 recordings, announcer on 45 recordings, narrator on 7 recordings, and writer on 1 recording), Joel Malone (writer on 60 recordings and producer on 7 recordings), Betty Lou Gerson (performer on 47 recordings), and Harold Swanton (writer on 42 recordings and director on 1 recording).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.5d1a575385a05456|CBS Pacific Network]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]] (rebroadcast by), [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]] (rebroadcast by), and [[org|org.244a08401c2c9142|WRVR-FM]] (originated at station).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include Murder and attempted murder, Greed and financial motive, Blackmail and coercion, Deception and concealed identity, Theft and robbery, and Insurance and inheritance schemes.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including West Coast regional network success, Signal Oil regional sponsorship, Radio-to-film noir franchise, and Radio mystery during the television transition.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]] (131 shared credited people), [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (111 shared credited people), [[show|escape|Escape]] (113 shared credited people), [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]] (93 shared credited people), and [[show|broadway-is-my-beat|Broadway Is My Beat]] (89 shared credited people).
